description: This file is a Java JUnit test class for the JournalEntryAggregationJobListener in the Fineract project. It tests the behavior of the listener's beforeJob method, verifying how it sets the aggregation date context based on previous aggregation state and configuration.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobListenerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the JournalEntryAggregationJobListener, testing the setup of job context prior to execution.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes tenant and business date context before each test.

methods.name: testBeforeJobWhenLastAggregatedOnDateNull
methods.description: Tests the behavior of beforeJob when no previous aggregation date exists; verifies context is set appropriately.

methods.name: testBeforeJobWithLastAggregatedOnDate
methods.description: Tests the behavior of beforeJob when a previous aggregation date exists; verifies context variables are set based on last aggregation.
